heading: People strengthening
intro: Meet faculty connected with the ERS–WVSU research community, including past presenters and contributors across economics and agribusiness. A profile here does not by itself imply a formal organizing role or past seminar presentation.
invitation_title: Bring an economic question to the room.
invitation_text: We welcome economists and researchers from other fields whose work offers a substantive opportunity for economic framing, data analysis, or causal inference.
